scripts.build: npm run build -w @vsm/api-contracts && npm run build -w @vsm/simulation-core && npm run build -w @vsm/api && npm run build -w @vsm/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @vsm/api-contracts && npm run build -w @vsm/simulation-core
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @vsm/api" "npm run dev -w @vsm/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
